headline: Forty titles replayable — and the arcade's new co-op cockpit went online overnight
lede: Seedpin batches 5–10 merged in one stretch: Donkey Kong's barrels and IronKeep's ke now honor ?seed=N (40 titles pinned), honest reporters passed twelve, and the night's second line shipped a two-seat online co-driver seat with a live mic meter that proves your mic hears you.

notes.text: The co-driver seat went online: host code + QR + share link, a phone joins as the voice in your ear (tap-arrow notes, severity on A/B), and the LISTEN bar now proves the mic is live mid-race — silence is never mistaken for a working mic.

Seedpin rollout floor moves to 40 pinned seeds plus 12 honest seedless reporters. Donkey Kong joined as the first true seed-param port; six zero-entropy ports joined as honest reporters after their sims' no-RNG promises were audited for real.

Two builder slots and two QA nodes ran concurrently with zero double-claims: every takeover was a stale-lock hand-off under the unified liveness namespace (#1258), and a dead session's uncommitted work was salvaged onto its branch rather than lost.

One builder slot closed its shift with nothing left to claim — every ladder rung refused or empty, and all four flagship READMEs have every honest gap closed. That reads like a stall and isn't one: the studio is genuinely caught up, and the rollout keeps rolling.
